feasibility.verdict: Partially feasible: precipitation partitioning into runoff, ET, and recharge can be simulated with single-column ELM across an elevation gradient, and runoff/SWE/WTD can be validated against observations; however ET cannot be directly validated (no flux towers), and single-column runs cannot reproduce spatially routed streamflow at the 93 gauges.
answerable: Column-scale water-balance partitioning of precipitation into surface+subsurface runoff, ET, and drainage/recharge (QDRAI) as fractions of precip
Elevation-dependence of partitioning (snow-dominated high elevation vs rain-dominated low elevation)
Validation of simulated SWE against 6 SNOTEL stations
Validation of simulated water-table depth against USGS wells (qualitative/trend)
Long-term mean annual water balance closure at each column
not_answerable: Direct validation of ET (no flux-tower observations in domain)
Fully routed basin-outlet streamflow hydrograph comparison to USGS gauges (requires river routing / distributed model, not single-column)
Lateral groundwater redistribution and true recharge to a regional aquifer (single-column has no lateral flow; recharge approximated by bottom drainage QDRAI)

parsed.n_justification: Elevation is the dominant control on precip partitioning in the Naches (352-1977 m spans rain to snow regimes). Five columns sample the elevation/climate gradient (low rain-dominated valley to high snow-dominated headwaters), each co-located near a SNOTEL station where possible for SWE validation, with soil texture varied to capture the secondary recharge/runoff control.
requires_capabilities: site-level surface dataset generation (soil texture, PFT) per column
GSWP3/CRUNCEP or downscaled meteorological forcing 1980-2018 for each column
USGS well WTD retrieval for validation
PFLOTRAN coupling (ELM-PFLOTRAN) optional for improved variably-saturated recharge estimate
assumptions: Recharge is approximated by simulated bottom-boundary drainage flux (QDRAI); true aquifer recharge requires PFLOTRAN or lateral-flow treatment
Runoff here is column-generated runoff (QRUNOFF = QOVER + QDRAI + QRGWL), not routed streamflow
ET validation is indirect via water-balance closure and SWE/WTD constraints given absence of flux towers
An accelerated-decomposition + regular spinup (>200 yr recycling 1980-2000 forcing) precedes the 1980-2018 transient run to equilibrate soil moisture and water table
Each column represents its local elevation band; sub-grid heterogeneity within HUC8 is not resolved
Default ELM vegetation/PFT distribution applied per column unless site-specific land cover is supplied
Annual partitioning fractions computed from long-term means to reduce interannual noise
